summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the default integration standard for AI agents in 2026, providing a universal way for LLMs to connect to external tools, data sources, and services. It matters because it decouples agent reasoning from tool implementation, letting any MCP-compatible assistant (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) securely call hundreds of standardized servers without bespoke integration code. The ecosystem now spans aggregator marketplaces, security gateways, and thousands of individual servers.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators are marketplaces/catalogs that let you discover and install many MCP servers from one place, gateways are proxies that sit between agents and servers to add auth, routing, and observability, while individual servers are the actual tool integrations that expose a specific app or capability (GitHub, Playwright, Figma, etc.) to the agent.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search and file operations
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; GitHub Team/Enterprise from $4/user/mo
strengths: Automates repo, issue, and PR workflows
Deep integration with Copilot and Cursor
tools.best_for: AI-driven repository management and automated code workflows

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web navigation, scraping, end-to-end UI testing
strengths: Lets agents control real browsers deterministically
Ideal for testing and automated QA healing workflows
tools.best_for: Agent-driven browser automation and web testing

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ app integrations (Slack, Gmail, Jira, Notion, GitHub) with managed auth and tool execution
tools.pricing_paid: Starter/paid plans from ~$29/mo; usage-based enterprise tiers
strengths: Managed authentication across hundreds of apps
Strong Cursor and agent framework support
tools.best_for: Teams wanting many integrations through one managed platform

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, frames, components and design-to-code context
tools.pricing_paid: Requires Figma plan; paid seats from ~$3-$15/user/mo
strengths: Official design-context provider for AI coding
tools.best_for: Converting Figma designs into production code with AI

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, tables, auth, storage and edge functions
strengths: Lets agents query and manage databases directly
Reads database rows as agent resources
tools.best_for: AI agents managing backend data and schema

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP hosting, OAuth, Workers, and routing agents to deployed servers
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plan from $5/mo plus usage
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting and auth
tools.best_for: Deploying and gating remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content read/write
strengths: Enables agents to read and update docs
tools.best_for: AI agents working with team knowledge and docs

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions and billing operations
tools.pricing_paid: Free server; standard Stripe transaction fees apply
tools.best_for: AI agents handling payments and billing tasks

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Marketplace and registry of thousands of MCP servers with one-click install/hosting
tools.best_for: Discovering and deploying MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Docker MCP Toolkit
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers with sandboxed execution and secret management via Docker MCP Catalog
tools.best_for: Securely running MCP servers in isolated containers

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error tracking, issues, performance data and debugging context
tools.best_for: AI-assisted debugging using production error data

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Community directory listing thousands of MCP servers and clients for discovery
tools.best_for: Browsing and discovering the full MCP ecosystem

tools.name: Slack MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Slack channels, messages, threads and workspace search
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; requires Slack plan
strengths: Most widely adopted Slack MCP (~1,800 GitHub stars)
tools.best_for: Agents reading and posting to Slack workspaces
